fact: The government tabled bill n° 040/2026 on electronic communications and digital infrastructure on 28 August 2026; article 10.2 requires administrative data to be hosted nationally with a certified data centre operator from a list to be fixed by order, and deputies deferred the bill to a later session on 5 September 2026, so it is not in force and the list is unpublished.
title: Loi sur l'hébergement des données à Madagascar
